summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K announcing the final tranche of its £2 billion share buyback programme, with up to approximately £0.18 billion to be repurchased starting May 11, 2026, through June 26, 2026, via a non-discretionary agreement with Citigroup Global Markets Limited. The programme, announced February 24, 2025, aims to return excess capital to shareholders and reduce share capital, enhancing EPS. Shares bought under this final tranche will be held as treasury shares. No specific price per share or premium is stated. Watch for completion timing and potential EPS impact.
